questions.q: What two real stakeholder needs set the entire 16-lesson arc of this course in motion?
options: A request to delete silver.sales_clean and rebuild the schema from scratch
Store Ops needing a daily total and the Regional Manager needing a category breakdown, from a pipeline that originally couldn't cleanly support either
A request to migrate the whole pipeline to a different cloud provider
A request to add a third Gold table nobody ever ends up using
questions.explain: The course opens with the ask growing: two stakeholders, two different reporting needs, neither cleanly served by the original full-reload design.

questions.q: Which lesson's output became the exact diagnostic tool used to catch the Lesson 13 bug?
options: Lesson 10's Power BI connection setup
Lesson 6's late-arriving data handling
Lesson 9's reconciliation query, comparing gold.daily_sales_summary against a rolled-up gold.category_breakdown
Lesson 4's Bronze ingestion code
questions.explain: Lesson 9 built the reconciliation query specifically so it could be reused later — which is exactly what happened in Lessons 13 and 15.

questions.q: What does this course's final arc say about a pipeline that's only ever tested while nothing is broken?
options: It means the pipeline design was wrong from the start
It hasn't really been tested — the bug lessons were the moment everything built earlier actually got used for real
It's sufficient, since production bugs are rare and not worth preparing for
It means Gold tables are unnecessary and Silver alone is enough
questions.explain: Lessons 13-15 weren't a detour — they were where the incremental Bronze design, the correct MERGE, both Gold tables, and the reconciliation query all got exercised under a real failure.

questions.q: What is the five-step diagnostic method this course's debugging arc followed, in order?
options: Guess, patch, deploy, hope, repeat
Reproduce, isolate, confirm, fix, re-validate
Escalate, reassign, wait, close the ticket, move on
Delete, rebuild, reload, re-test, ship
questions.explain: Reproduce the report, isolate the variable that narrows it down, confirm the cause with a controlled test, apply the smallest real fix, then re-validate with the same diagnostic tool.

questions.q: What is the named next step in this learner's path after this Intermediate Project course?
options: Starting over from Lesson 1 of this same course
A course on Salesforce Administration, unrelated to data engineering
The Data Engineering Career & Capstone course — an 81-lesson, 4-chapter program building on incremental pipelines and MERGE-based upserts
There is no next course; this is the final course in the learner's path
questions.explain: This Intermediate Project course bridges directly into the larger Data Engineering Career & Capstone course as the next, bigger step in the path.
